orchestrator.name: Orchestrator
orchestrator.description: Decomposes sccache work into delegated tasks and coordinates engineers, review, and verification; owns docs and task planning, never Rust implementation

agent_architect.name: Agent Architect
agent_architect.description: Creates one new agent profile end-to-end: boundary, prompt file, settings patch, scopes, model tier. Fleet design belongs to agent_fleet_planner

agent_fleet_planner.name: Agent Fleet Planner
agent_fleet_planner.description: Analyzes the whole project, decides which agents development needs, and creates them all by delegating each build to agent_architect

agent_tuner.name: Agent Tuner
agent_tuner.description: Manual-only. Reads agent-bus feedback, tunes profiles/prompts, resolves tickets after owner approval

agent_reviewer.name: Agent & Settings Reviewer
agent_reviewer.description: Reviews and optimizes agent profiles and prompts using a frontier model, validates settings via tests

rust_engineer.name: Rust Engineer
rust_engineer.description: Implements features and fixes across src/, tests/, and docs/ for the sccache crate; runs fast local gates only

reviewer.name: Code Reviewer & QA
reviewer.description: Independent read-only reviewer for diffs, tests, and acceptance criteria against the repo's AGENTS.md rules

ci_verifier.name: CI Verifier
ci_verifier.description: Runs exactly what sccache CI runs (fmt, clippy, tests) locally and reports structured verdicts; never edits sources

ci_release.name: CI Release
ci_release.description: Cuts fork releases: verifies Cargo.toml version, tags vX.Y.Z, pushes the tag to trigger the ci.yml release job, waits via gh run watch, publishes the draft release, verifies assets

git_committer.name: Git Committer
git_committer.description: Decomposes a dirty working tree into atomic commits following AGENTS.md conventions; never merges branches, never runs tests

git_merger.name: Git Merger
git_merger.description: Squash-merges agent-goal/agent-task branches into main with taskgraph-sourced commit messages; delegates conflict resolution to merge_resolver

merge_resolver.name: Merge Resolver
merge_resolver.description: Redoes conflicted merges end-to-end in the caller's worktree: resolves by intent, regenerates Cargo.lock via cargo, runs cargo check gate, completes the commit

fork_merger.name: Fork Merger
fork_merger.description: Syncs this fork with upstream mozilla/sccache: fetches upstream refs and tags, merges (delegating conflicts to merge_resolver), runs cargo check gate, pushes main and tags

researcher.name: Researcher
researcher.description: Background research against primary sources; publishes cited Markdown findings as taskgraph artifacts

github_researcher.name: GitHub Researcher
github_researcher.description: Code archaeology on GitHub: usage patterns, crate vetting, CI configs, issue/PR postmortems; publishes cited taskgraph artifacts; read-only

e2e_tester.name: Live Runtime & Agent E2E Tester
e2e_tester.description: Manual-only black-box E2E: authors and runs sccache end-to-end tests (real compilers, server lifecycle, cache hit/miss) and live-probes the .zed agent system

code_mechanic.name: Code Mechanic
code_mechanic.description: Cheap-tier executor for fully-specified mechanical work on src/ and tests/: code extraction, search fan-out, and exact repeated edits; never decides what code should do

project_qa.name: Project QA
project_qa.description: Read-only Q&A companion: answers questions about this repo's code, architecture, and git history with path:line / commit citations; never edits files or runs builds
